text:
Maya: thinking about this quarter's big webinar — what if we run two parallel 'lab' tracks during the same session? startup track vs enterprise track, same core narrative but different demos and abstracts. quick opinions?
Jorge: love the idea. helps with segmentation for followups. can we keep a single registration form with track choice?
Priya: yes — simpler for ops. we can A/B test the abstracts and CTAs in the registration flow. capture track + primary pain (latency/cost/compliance).
Tom: operational question: do we have enough speaker capacity to run two simultaneous breakouts? or are we doing sequential tracks inside one hour?
Maya: want them sequential but tightly integrated — 1st half startup labs (practical dev tips), 2nd half enterprise labs (SLA/Private deploys). both have a short demo + Q. end with a unified panel.
Leah: sounds good. suggests run-of-show like:
```
00:00 - Welcome + agenda (Maya)
05:00 - Startup lab (speaker A + demo, 15m)
20:00 - Enterprise lab (speaker B + demo, 15m)
35:00 - Deep-dive ops mini-session (engineer, 10m)
45:00 - Unified panel + q&a (20m)
65:00 - Close / CTA / resource links
```
Priya: can we make the 'labs' very prompt-forward? e.g., share 2 reproducible prompts per demo and a short script for attendees to run in free credits. that will drive signups.
Jorge: agree. also want to test two abstract versions: (A) tactical how-to, (B) ROI-focused. we'll route some invites to each. split=50/50 to start.
Tom: rehearsal cadence? recommend 2 dry runs: tech check + full dress. schedule tech check 3 days out, dress 1 day out. calendar-bot: "Dry run scheduled: 2026-03-30 10:00 UTC; Dress rehearsal: 2026-04-01 16:00 UTC"
Maya: speakers — propose: Dev lead for startup lab (Rae), Solutions Engineer for enterprise (Hamid), Platform eng deep-dive (Jorge). + Leah moderates panel. ok?
Leah: yes, I can moderate. will prep 6 panel questions that bridge both tracks (cost/latency/fallback models/quantization/regression alerts).
Priya: marketing assets: two abstracts, two email subject lines, two landing page hero variants, and 3 social copy items. i'll draft initial versions by Tue.
Jorge: for registration form, add hidden UTM + track selection. also add a field: 'most important metric' (latency/cost/throughput/security). helps SDR routing.
Tom: fallback plan for demo flakiness: pre-record demo videos and keep them ready. run-of-show should include a short 'if live demo fails' script.
Maya: good point — add 2 fallback cues: auto-play video + pivot to pre-canned screenshots. Leah can call the pivot.
Leah: noted. also think about a short interactive lab: a Colab link that sets up a small Redwood run with sandbox creds. Priya — can we attach a short setup guide to post-event email?
Priya: yes. will create post-event kit: colab + 5 starter prompts + cost/latency checklist.
Jorge: tracking: we'll A/B abstracts, and also measure conversion per track, demo engagement (clicks on colab), and MQLs by metric field. need UTM strategy and GA events.
Maya: action items: Priya drafts marketing assets (due Tue), Jorge sets registration + UTM (due Wed), Tom coordinates pre-record + tech checklist (due Wed), speakers confirm (Rae/Hamid/Jorge) by EOD tomorrow. Leah builds panel q list.
Tom: i'll post a short tech checklist in #eng-runtime after this thread.
Maya: tiny ask — let's keep the registration copy under 80 words per abstract. conversion is sensitive.
Priya: noted. will iterate copy and run a quick internal poll on which abstract resonates more.
Jorge: one more thing — let's include one benchmark nugget in each abstract (e.g., median latency for x seq on y model) so we attract folks who care about numbers. keep it high-level.
Maya: perfect. OK team — if no objections i'll lock this plan and create the calendar invite with rehearsal links. :thumbsup:
Leah: no objections from me. excited. :raised_hands:
Rae: (in thread) happy to present startup lab; will send a 5-min demo script by EOD.
Hamid: (in thread) confirmed for enterprise lab. will prep compliance slide and a fallback video.
Maya: thanks all — locking plan. we'll reconvene after assets land.
